name: Beggar to Emperor
detailed_description:
Game Introduction

‘Beggar to Emperor’ is a strategic simulation RPG set in the fictional medieval continent of Legia, where you begin as a penniless beggar and shape your own destiny through countless choices and experiences.
You start at the very bottom of society with nothing, but your future is entirely up to you.
Rise through the social ranks—become a laborer, merchant, thief, vigilante, priest, knight, noble, or even royalty—gathering wealth and influence through your own path.
And ultimately, you may unify the continent and ascend to the throne as Emperor.

Structure of Power and Organizations

Each organization features multiple paths to promotion: earn merit, buy your way up, win honor through formal duels, or seize power by force.
To become the leader of an organization, you may be elected through a vote or claim the position by overthrowing the current head.
However you choose to climb, every action carries its own consequences.

Army Development and Warfare

Recruit and train your own army through a wide range of methods, and develop it in any direction you see fit.
Assemble talented individuals, train them into elite units, and lead them into battle.
Your army's strength will influence not only the outcome of war, but also the balance of political and diplomatic power across the continent.

Gathering, Production, and Economic Activity

Engage in resource collection activities such as logging, fishing, farming, mining, and hunting to gather materials.
These resources can sustain your livelihood or fuel trade and commerce, allowing you to accumulate vast wealth.
Alternatively, you can pursue unorthodox methods such as begging or theft—all paths are valid means of economic activity, and each leads to your own form of growth.

Exploration, Social Interaction, and Life Choices

Explore every corner of Legia to uncover hidden treasures, mysterious ruins, and unique locations.
Meet countless characters, form alliances or rivalries, and lead your forces into war or politics.
You may marry into nobility to pursue greater ambitions, or live freely as a wandering adventurer.
Every experience and consequence is driven by your choices.
Reflecting the life of a medieval citizen, the game also includes systems like taxes, arrest by vigilantes, imprisonment, and bail.

Write Your Own Story

‘Beggar to Emperor’ is a unique journey where you build your own army, pursue any path you desire, and freely write your own story.
Live the Middle Ages your way—the choice is always yours.

Main Features

  • Start with nothing and carve out a new life through free choices.

  • Experience a wide range of professions and social statuses; rise to the top of any organization.

  • Build relationships with a variety of characters.

  • Train and lead the greatest army on the continent.

  • Earn money or gather resources through logging, fishing, farming, mining, and hunting.

  • Make your fortune through honest work, begging, banditry, other crimes, or trade your way to becoming a wealthy merchant.

  • Research and craft the most powerful weapons and armor.

  • Freely explore every corner of an open world continent.

  • Find a lifelong companion through marriage, or make strategic choices to climb the political ladder.

  • Expand your influence and vie for the throne through war, diplomacy, and political decisions.

  • If you go bankrupt or lose a battle, you may find yourself penniless once again—grow stronger to survive.
